## pb-ids-alert (N8N-4.4)
**Trigger:** called by lib-alert-queue-drain through Execute Workflow (waited for; by recv-wazuh-alert, not waited for, only when the queue is unavailable), when lib-route-alert routes the alert here: row `ids-network-alert` (groups suricata or ids: 101000, 101001, 101010 `ET SCAN`, which wins over network-scan) of lib-config `routing`.
**Inputs:** `{alert: <raw Wazuh alert>, config: <lib-config>, recv_execution_id, route: <lib-route-alert route>}`, as pb-generic.
**Actions taken:** **lib-alert-base** (the shared chain: normalize -> extract observables (ip for data.src_ip / data.dest_ip, tagged src / dst) -> warninglists -> TheHive alert -> created: enrichment through Cortex (C6); duplicate: the repair check; custom field and metrics `playbook` = pb-ids-alert) -> created or repaired only: **remote party and verdict**: of the alert's ip observables tagged src / dst, the one tagged neither range:internal nor agent (the source first; both internal, a LAN attack: the source, unless it is the agent's own address; documentation ranges count as remote); no such address: no remote party, said in the writeback, nothing below. Its verdict from the enrichment (on a repair, from its asox:verdict= tag): suspicious or malicious -> the alert gets the tag `asox:verdict=<verdict>`; malicious -> its severity raised to lib-config `ids.escalate_severity` (4) if lower, before the writeback, so the asox-metrics document is created with it; otherwise nothing. One `PATCH /api/v1/alert/<id>` (TheHive retry pattern N8N-6.2; a failure is reported, never parked) -> **related IDS alerts** (read-only): one bounded TheHive query (`POST /api/v1/query?name=ids-related`, retry pattern, at most `ids.query_limit` 50) for other alerts tagged suricata, dated within `ids.correlation_window_s` (3600 s) of this alert's event time either way, not this alert, whose Suricata EVE line (the description's log block) has the remote address as src_ip / dest_ip or the same signature_id (TheHive's token search on the description pre-filters, the EVE line is checked exactly); no tags or writes on them; a failed query is reported, never parked -> lib-thehive-writeback (lib-alert-base's sections, then the IDS facts (signature, signature_id, category, Suricata severity, protocol, src_ip:src_port -> dest_ip:dest_port, sensor), the remote party and its verdict, the tag and severity lines, "Related IDS alerts (1 h)": the total, how many share the remote address and the signature, up to `ids.max_listed` (10) with TheHive id, Wazuh id, signature, remote, host and time, and `Recommended: review the remote address; blocking needs response on the attacked host (C9 scope: SSH playbook only); nothing was changed.`). Never suppresses, closes, merges or lowers anything (D12); creates no case; no response action (C9).
**Systems changed:** TheHive (this alert: alert, comments, observable tags and IOC flag, the alert's verdict tag and a severity raise) and the Wazuh indexer (the alert's asox-metrics document, C11); Cortex and MISP run read-only lookups.
**Approval:** not needed: SOC bookkeeping only (TheHive tags, comments, severity raise; asox-metrics), no system changes.
**Owner:** n8n.
Result: pb-generic's (`outcome`, `metrics`, `enrichment`, ...) plus `remote_verdict` (remote, side, verdict, tag, severity from/to, update) and `related` (status, total, same_remote, same_signature, listed). Error workflow: recv-n8n-error.
